Dal Paratha
home food 101 | indian food | elevate everyday cooking 
serve up your leftover dal in the form of these super tasty parathas

Nutrition: 
C: 22 | F: 3 | P: 5
Calories: 117 per paratha 
Makes 6-7 parathas depending on size

Ingredients
160 grams whole wheat flour
1 tsp salt or more as needed
1 tsp red chilli powder
2 green chillies, finely chopped 
i forgot to add coriander, but you should definately add some :) 
150 grams leftover dal , i use this amount as my dal is quite thick, if using a thinner dal, you need to adjust the amount to get a proper dough consistency . do not add all dal at once as it might lead to the dough being too thick 

Method: 
add flour to a bowl and add in all the ingredients 
with regard to the amount of dal in the recipe, please note: my dal is quite thick hence the amount i have used to form a dough, if using a thinner dal, you need to adjust the amount to get a proper dough consistency 
do not add all dal at once as it might lead to the dough being too wet
leave it to rest for 30 minutes 
divide into 6-7 balls and roll out as you would a regular chapati
cook on a tava and add a little ghee if you want :) 
serve with dahi and pickle and my favorite tomato subzi
